predecessor.historical_negative_unchanged: S17 assay INVALID due kernel history-swap and S16 learned-plasticity NULL.

hypothesis: Can an attention-free learned numeric (state,action) feature representation, trained only on one nonlinear law, transfer without training to TWO distinct previously unseen nonlinear function families versus calibration-only RBF-KRR and the exact initial untrained features? Does sequential training on one of those new families preserve original-law prediction rather than catastrophic interference?

arms.type: trainable 2→32→12 tanh MLP on raw state/action, 12-dim ridge adaptive coefficients per world; same initial MLP as random
identical initial MLP but never trained; same ridge coefficient adaptation
strong conventional RBF kernel ridge over raw (x,u); gamma, decay, regularization CALIBRATION-ONLY
32-unit GRU on raw 4-channel continuous history with query-conditioned 3-channel 32-unit MLP future-derivative head
evaluator uses hidden world parameters only to generate ground-truth targets
negative context swap for learned feature and RBF predictors

world.generator: S16 original source generation for A and original-source OOD; S19 separate evaluator law for new sine and rational worlds (hidden coefficients). No analytic nonlinear basis disclosed to learned, random, GRU or RBF controls.
world.nonlinear_family: S16 original law xnext=x+dt*(-a*x+b*u+c*tanh(2*x)+d*x*u) only during phase A; zero-shot S19 laws are new functional families.
world.unseen_function_split: xnext uses tanh(3*x) after switch, unknown to candidates; OOD parameter ranges as S16
world.physics_bias_disclosure: Estimator model uses the known Euler residual (xnext-x)/dt and supervised counterfactual target, so it has a discrete-time numerical dynamics prior, but no correct nonlinear feature formula.

calibration.tie_breaker: argmin mean calibration MSE then smaller gamma then larger decay then larger ridge; never use test splits to select

phases.A: train 240 original S16 tanh(2x)/x*u worlds, then evaluate three disjoint OOD families
phases.B: train the same pretrained feature and GRU models for exactly 96 updates on NEW sine family with distinct train-range coefficients; then evaluate SOURCE (old) and NOVEL SINE (new) on same frozen heldout splits as before without optimizer access
phases.calibration: kernel hyperparameters chosen ONCE on original training-range switching worlds, never retuned on new families, original or second-phase heldouts

novel_sine.independent_of_source: Contains no tanh(2*x) or x*u term

novel_rational.independent_of_source: Different damping law and two new nonlinear features; no source tanh(2*x) feature multiplied by c, no x*u term

parameter_ranges.train_A: S16 world original latent train ranges

novel_family_definitions.world_switch: At transition 20 of 32, replace all four latent coefficients with independently sampled unknown coefficients; no switch label in model input

classifications.research_bounds: Development-only: two separately generated synthetic families. Both predictors get sampled time, Euler derivatives and online per-world regression. No general intelligence, natural world perception, unsampled analog computation, self-improvement or independent science claim.
classifications.not_posthoc: Thresholds, sample seeds, new laws, the sequential intervention and negative controls fixed before execution; report all fails unaltered.
classifications.provenance_note: S18 positive and S17 invalid preserved, not reinterpreted.

stop_conditions: invalid oracle or source positive controls
